transport: COMMAND_INT only; MAV_CMD_USER_1 (31010), experimental project-local SITL contract; not a new dialect or stock mission command
param2: task ID: integral float from 1 through 65535
param3: speed_mps: finite, positive according to upstream is_positive (>FLT_EPSILON), and <=2; retained limit only, not applied
param4: radius_m: finite, from 0.5 through 2; retained condition only, not evaluated
x: WGS84 latitude in signed degrees times 1e7, inclusive [-90,90] degrees
y: WGS84 longitude in signed degrees times 1e7, inclusive [-180,180] degrees
z: finite height above home in metres, from 0.01 through 10 inclusive; stored rounded to nearest cm
range_origin: current estimated home at admission; its latitude/longitude/altitude copied with accepted task
source_gate: gcs().sysid_is_gcs(msg.sysid), configured GCS system-ID range; not cryptographic identity/authentication
navigation_gate: home_is_set and stock absolute EKF position eligibility with no EKF failsafe; includes stock predicted absolute position while disarmed
memory: one RAM slot, reset at process restart, no persistence or execution API
duplicates: same ID and same cm-resolution goal with upstream floating-point comparison tolerance for speed/radius is acknowledged duplicate without replacing state; changed same ID rejected; other valid ID rejected busy
rejection: preserve existing task/home; report short STATUSTEXT reason and standard COMMAND_ACK
execution_authority: none: cannot arm, change mode, set a navigation target or drive a motor
reset_limit: captured home is evidence of admission reference, not a permanent authorization; L10 must revalidate home/origin/navigation resets and current limits before execution
